title: "Storm Descends"
next_chapter_hook: "Just when everyone thought the storm had passed, Chen Ji saw a pair of eyes watching him in the Tianji Record's premonition—those eyes originated from Ling Yuan."

text.content: "The midnight bell echoed across Tianqing Sect, deep and lingering, as if拉开序幕 for the coming blood rain. Chen Ji stood on the stone steps outside the Council Hall, his robes fluttering violently in the night wind. In the depths of his eyes, the runes of the Tianji Record slowly circulated—that was the foresight he had purchased two hours ago at the cost of five Heavenly Fate points. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his mind: 'Boy, the hour approaches. Are you certain you want to act now?' Chen Ji's lips curved slightly, that smile cold as frost: 'Mr. Mo, it's time to close the net.'"

dialogue.content: "The Tianji Record Fragment burned slightly hot in your Mental Sea, Mo Xiansheng's fragmented soul phantom flickering: 'The Five Elders' remaining faction's deployment tonight, I have told you everything. That fellow named Zhao Quan has also colluded with two Golden Core stage experts from the Demonic Path,埋伏 in the east side hall. If you wish to eliminate them all, you must first break their formation.' Chen Ji replied calmly: 'I have already had someone secretly replace the formation's core.' Mo Xiansheng sighed softly: 'You brat, your meticulousness is something even I find hard to see through.'"

text.content: "Inside the Council Hall, candles blazed brightly. The Five Elders' remaining faction had gathered tonight under the pretext of 'discussing tomorrow's Sect Tournament matters,' but undercurrents churned beneath the surface. Zhao Quan sat in the third seat on the left, his fingers continuously tapping the table, anxiety flickering in his eyes. Beside him, the two black-robed cultivators kept their qi restrained, yet could not conceal that peculiar yin-cold aura of the Demonic Path. Chen Ji watched it all静静 from the shadows outside the door, his gaze cold as a blade. He saw it—the rebellion these people would launch in two hours, their attempt to seize control of the sect while the Grand Elder was in seclusion."

"Yet they did not know that Chen Ji had already seen through this entire chess game. He saw the proof of Zhao Quan's collusion with the Demonic Path, saw the trapping formation they had布置, and even saw their狼狈模样 after defeat. These premonitions were not vague images, but vivid paintings down to every detail. At this moment, what Chen Ji held in his hand was not merely a Tianji Record Fragment, but ironclad evidence enough to shake the entire Tianqing Sect."

choice.prompt: "At the third quarter of midnight, Zhao Quan was about to rise and announce the action. Chen Ji decided to strike first—how would he publicly expose this evidence?"

choices.text: "Charge in head-on, publicly read the accusations"
choices.description: "Burst into the Council Hall with absolute force, publicly read the evidence before everyone, leaving the Five Elders' remnants no room to deny, and complete the net-closing with absolute碾压之姿."
choices.risk_hint: "The enemy may act desperately and attack on the spot"

text.content: "Chen Ji kicked open the Council Hall's doors, the candlelight instantly illuminating his cold and resolute features. His voice was not loud, yet it clearly spread throughout the entire hall: 'Zhao Quan, do you want me to publicly read the ironclad evidence of your collusion with the Demonic Path and your treasonous intentions?' The words fell, and he had already flung out a stack of Jade Slips. The slips exploded in midair, countless images flickering like a carousel before everyone's eyes—scenes of Zhao Quan in secret talks with Demonic Path envoys, the exchange of tokens, and the silk scroll detailing tonight's action plan. The entire hall was shocked."

choices.text: "Lure the tiger from the mountain, trap the turtle in the jar"
choices.description: "First have Han Lie seal off the perimeter with his men, then lure Zhao Quan and the others into the preset trap, and finally close the door to beat the dog—leaving the enemy with no chance to escape."
choices.visible_reward: "Combat Power +10, not a single enemy soldier escapes"
choices.risk_hint: "Han Lie is impulsive by nature and may expose the plan"

text.content: "Chen Ji gave a hand signal to Han Lie in the shadows. The first genius of Xuanwu Sect coldly snorted, then quietly dispersed with over a dozen core disciples. The moment Zhao Quan thought everything was ready and rose to announce the action, the four doors of the hall were suddenly sealed shut by a formation array. Han Lie kicked over a Demonic Path expert trying to flee, roaring: 'Trying to run? I've been waiting for this moment!' Zhao Quan's face turned deathly pale—he simply could not understand why his meticulously arranged killing formation had instead trapped himself."

choices.text: "Invite the guest into the jar, use their own methods against them"
choices.description: "Let the enemy strike first, while appearing as the 'victim.' Use the enemy's hand to expose their conspiracy, achieving a perfect case of pretending to be a pig to eat the tiger."
choices.visible_reward: "Charm +20, let everyone witness the enemy's cruelty firsthand"
choices.risk_hint: "May be accidentally injured, but can arouse everyone's sympathy"

text.content: "Chen Ji slowly walked into the hall, wearing a look of complete 'innocence' as he gazed at Zhao Quan: 'Uncle Zhao, holding a council meeting this late at night—what important matters require discussion?' A murderous glint flashed in Zhao Quan's eyes. Thinking the opportunity had arrived, he suddenly erupted: 'Important matters? Just to take your worthless life!' His attack came swift and fierce, yet stopped abruptly three inches before Chen Ji's body—not because he halted, but because the Grand Elder's protective spiritual light had blocked it all. The Grand Elder, who had been hiding for so long, emerged from the shadows, his voice like thunder: 'Zhao Quan, you indeed have wolfish ambitions!'"

"Regardless of which strategy Chen Ji chose, the ironclad evidence continued playing in the air. The faces of the Five Elders' remnant faction shifted from confusion to terror, then from terror to despair. The two Demonic Path Golden Core experts saw the situation turning bad and attempted to flee using Demonic Path secret arts, but Han Lie, who had been prepared,一拳轰碎 their protective spiritual light. They crashed heavily to the ground, spitting blood. 'Is this all you've got, daring to run amok in Tianqing Sect?' Han Lie coldly laughed, 'Do you think the people of Xuanwu Sect are pushovers?'"

dialogue.content: "Han Lie brushed the dust off his clothes and walked to Chen Ji's side, looking at him with a complex gaze: 'You废物...' He paused, seemingly searching for words, 'The four characters '算无遗策'—you deserve them.' Coming from the first genius of Xuanwu Sect, the weight of these words made everyone present gasp. Han Lie never praised others easily, especially not a '废物' he had once looked down upon. Yet tonight, he witnessed firsthand how Chen Ji manipulated everything within his palm. That kind of shock was beyond words."

text.content: "Zhao Quan knelt on the ground, trembling violently like a sieve. He pointed at Chen Ji, his eyes filled with utter disbelief: 'You... you're clearly a废物! A servant disciple! How could... how could you possibly know all this!' Chen Ji slowly approached, looking down at this former invincible aide of the Fifth Elder from above. His voice was soft, yet every word rang clear to everyone: 'Uncle Zhao, you've forgotten one thing—a废物 is simply what I wanted you to see.'"

choice.prompt: "Zhao Quan has become a prisoner. How will Chen Ji deal with these Five Elders' remnant faction?"

choices.text: "Root out the weeds and leave no future trouble"
choices.description: "Since we've already torn up face, there's no need to show mercy. Directly abolish their cultivation and hand them over to the sect—eliminate all future troubles permanently."
choices.visible_cost: "May gain a reputation for being ruthless"
choices.visible_reward: "Darkness Value +5, enemies completely lose threat capability"
choices.risk_hint: "The Grand Elder may have reservations about killing"

text.content: "Chen Ji raised his hand, a sharp sword qi slicing through the night air, directly abolishing Zhao Quan's cultivation. That scream of agony echoed through the hall, yet no one dared speak a word of plea. 'Take him away.' Chen Ji ordered casually, 'Hand him over to the sect's Law Enforcement Hall for processing.' When the two Demonic Path experts saw Zhao Quan's fate, their faces turned deathly pale. Wanting to end themselves, they were stopped by Han Lie's quick reflexes as he sealed their acupoints. They could only watch as Tianqing Sect disciples dragged them away. From beginning to end, Chen Ji's expression remained calm as still water, as if he was merely handling a trivial matter."

choices.description: "Don't kill, but let everyone see the outcome of traitors. Public trial, execute justice according to law, deter all那些心怀不轨之人."
choices.visible_cost: "Requires time to prepare for public trial"
choices.visible_reward: "Reputation +20, let the entire sect witness your methods"
choices.risk_hint: "Takes a long time, unexpected changes may occur"

text.content: "Chen Ji did not rush to act. Instead, he turned to the elders and disciples present, his voice clear and bright: 'Fellow brothers and sisters, tonight's events—I'm sure everyone has seen. The Five Elders' rebellion, collusion with the Demonic Path, intent to subvert the sect. According to sect rules, this deserves the harshest punishment. But I, Chen Ji, believe death is too easy for them—why not hold a public trial tomorrow at noon in the sect plaza? Let everyone see the face of a traitor.' At these words, everyone whispered among themselves, yet no one objected. After all, compared to secret execution, a public trial better demonstrated the sect's majesty."

choices.text: "Abolish their cultivation and expel from the sect"
choices.description: "Leave them their lives, but abolish all their cultivation—living worse than death. This brings more despair than killing them."
choices.visible_cost: "May be seen as too merciful by others"
choices.risk_hint: "There may be fish that slip through, seeking revenge"

text.content: "Chen Ji contemplated for a moment, then made an unexpected decision: 'Abolish their cultivation and expel them from the sect.' Upon hearing this, Zhao Quan's face turned ashen, yet faintly showed relief of having escaped death. However, Chen Ji's next words turned that relief into despair instantly: 'Oh right, I forgot to tell you—I will let the entire sect know the reason for your expulsion. For the rest of your life, you will live under the name of 'Traitor,' spending your days amid everyone's cold shoulders and spittle.' Zhao Quan let out a wretched cry and actually fainted on the spot. Compared to death, this punishment of living worse than death was a true nightmare."

"Having dealt with all this, peace finally returned to the Council Hall. Yet everyone's heart was churning with惊天骇浪. That servant disciple who had been mocked by all, tonight displayed everything that completely overturned their understanding. Chen Ji's cunning, his methods, and that从容 of having everything under control—all made those present feel deep reverence. Someone began to re-examine this young man—what secrets still lay hidden in his eyes?"

dialogue.content: "Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in Chen Ji's Mental Sea, carrying a hint of satisfaction: 'Well done, boy. However...' He shifted topics, 'In the moment of your triumph, did you notice those eyes in the corner?' Chen Ji's heart tightened. Following Mo Xiansheng's hint, he looked over to see a blurred figure flash and vanish in the dark corner of the Council Hall. That figure's aura... seemed familiar, as if he had sensed it somewhere before. Chen Ji's gaze sank, alarm bells ringing in his heart. This variable was not within the Tianji Record's premonition."

text.content: "At this moment, the Grand Elder slowly approached. His gaze lingered on Chen Ji for a long while, complex light flickering in his eyes: 'Chen Ji, tonight's matter—you handled it very well.' His voice was not loud, yet carried undeniable authority, 'From today forward, you are hereby appointed Outer Sect Officer of this sect, enjoying all privileges of an Inner Disciple.' At this declaration, the entire hall erupted in commotion. While Outer Sect Officer was not a high position, skipping several levels directly was an immense honor. The Grand Elder continued: 'Furthermore, no one shall ever again refer to Chen Ji with the term '废物.' Those who violate will be tried for contempt of sect rules.'"

"Chen Ji respectfully bowed: 'Thank you for the Grand Elder's generous favor. This disciple will not disappoint.' Yet his mind was rapidly spinning—the Grand Elder's attitude changed too quickly; there must be a reason. Connecting the fleeting shadow from earlier and Mo Xiansheng's warning, Chen Ji vaguely formed a guess: Was the Grand Elder's vigorous promotion genuine admiration, or did it hide ulterior motives? More importantly, who was that mysterious figure? Why hadn't the Tianji Record foreseen this person's existence?"

dialogue.content: "Han Lie walked up to Chen Ji, rare lowering his voice: 'Chen Ji, those two people just now... were not ordinary Demonic Path cultivators.' His expression was grave beyond compare, 'I recognized the aura of one of them—a scout from the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path.' Holy Sect of the Demonic Path—the leader among the four major Demonic Path forces, whose Holy Maiden was Ye Qing. Han Lie continued: 'The Five Elders' remnant faction colluding with the Holy Sect—this matter probably isn't so simple. You...' He paused, seemingly searching for the right words, 'Be careful of those who stab you in the back.' With that, he patted Chen Ji's shoulder and turned to leave."

text.content: "The night wind brushed past the stone steps outside the Council Hall. Chen Ji stood alone under the moonlight. His Tianji Record Fragment burned slightly hot—that was the backlash from consuming Heavenly Fate points. Yet compared to physical exhaustion, what concerned him more were the various suspicious points exposed tonight. Was the force behind the Five Elders truly only this much? What was the background of that unseen mysterious person? More importantly, was the Grand Elder's sudden favor a blessing or a curse? Chen Ji raised his head toward the night sky—stars dim, as if预示 a larger storm was brewing. Mo Xiansheng's voice murmured: 'Boy, this is only the beginning.'"

choice.prompt: "The storm has temporarily calmed, but new clouds of suspicion hang over his heart. Chen Ji decides his next move—"

choices.description: "That figure was far too suspicious and must be identified quickly. Even if it costs more Heavenly Fate points, he must keep everything under control."
choices.risk_hint: "If the other party is a great power, it may backfire"

text.content: "Chen Ji quietly activated the Tianji Record, attempting to trace that mysterious figure's whereabouts. However, just as he was about to touch the truth, a terrifying counterattack force suddenly struck—the Tianji Record's images became blurred, as if some force was deliberately blocking them. Mo Xiansheng's voice turned sharply tense: 'Not good! It's interference from Heavenly Dao Will! That person carries its aura!' Chen Ji's heart was greatly shaken—Heavenly Dao Will... that ultimate great villain had actually extended its reach into Tianqing Sect?"

choices.description: "Since the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path is involved, why not directly ask Ye Qing for clarification? Her 'Demonic Path Mist' may cover up the Tianji Record's leakage."
choices.visible_cost: "Must expose some of his trump cards"
choices.visible_reward: "Relationship with Ye Qing +20, gain strategic-level ally support"

text.content: "Chen Ji contacted Ye Qing through a secret method. After a moment, a cold voice rang in his Mental Sea: 'Chen Ji? You actually dare contact me proactively?' Chen Ji got straight to the point, transmitting tonight's discoveries over. Ye Qing remained silent for a long while. When she spoke again, her tone was grave: 'Those two scouts... were sent from within the Holy Sect. My 'Demonic Path Mist' can conceal the Tianji Record's aura, but you must be careful—among the Holy Sect's higher-ups, someone does not wish you to live.' These words made Chen Ji's heart sink heavily. The enemy's scheme was far deeper than he had imagined."

choices.description: "Tonight has been enough. What matters most now is to stabilize the situation and let the enemy reveal their weaknesses first."
choices.visible_cost: "May miss the opportunity to strike first"
choices.visible_reward: "Heavenly Fate +5, maintain an air of mystery"
choices.risk_hint: "The enemy may take the chance to make arrangements"

text.content: "Chen Ji took a deep breath, suppressing the restlessness in his heart. He knew that sometimes doing nothing was the best action. Excessive investigation would only expose more flaws—better to wait for the right moment, letting the enemy reveal their own mistakes. He turned and left the Council Hall, vanishing into the night. However, the instant he departed, an elderly figure emerged from the shadows—the Grand Elder. His gaze fell upon the direction where Chen Ji had disappeared, a meaningful glint flickering in his eyes."

"Returning to his dwelling, Chen Ji finally had time to organize tonight's gains. The Five Elders' remnant faction was completely eliminated; his reputation and status had greatly improved. Yet the various anomalies revealed by the Tianji Record made him realize this chess game was far more complex than he had imagined. Heavenly Dao Will's interference, the mysterious person's appearance, the Grand Elder's favor... behind every move, there seemed to be invisible hands at work. Chen Ji closed his eyes, the Tianji Record Fragment slowly rotating in his Mental Sea. He saw blurry fragments of the next three days—the Sect Tournament was about to begin, and at that tournament, someone would publicly challenge him. Who would that person be?"

"Mo Xiansheng's voice murmured: 'Boy, tonight you consumed five Heavenly Fate points in exchange for this great victory. But remember—every premonition is a leak of Heavenly Secrets to the Heavenly Dao Will. It is already watching you.' Chen Ji opened his eyes, his gaze deep and dark: 'Let it watch.' A cold smile curved his lips, 'After all, from the moment I obtained the Tianji Record, I never intended to be a rule-following chess piece.' Outside the window, the east was already turning white. A new day was about to begin, and the true storm was only just arriving."
